sections.heading: One Crew for the Whole Outside of Your House
body: Water is what wears out the outside of a house. It comes off the roof, runs past the edge, down the wall, around the windows and into the wood under the paint.
Gutters, siding, trim, paint and decks are all ways of keeping it out. When one of them fails, the water finds the next.
That's why we do all of it. The crew that hangs your gutters can see where else the water is getting in, so you hire one crew instead of five contractors.
We're insured, the estimate is free, and we take 10% off for veterans and retirees. We bring over eight years of experience to every job.

sections.heading: Gutters
body: You notice it when it rains. Water pours over the edge instead of down the downspout, the siding below is streaked, and there's a puddle by the foundation.
Gutters fail in a few ordinary ways. They clog with leaves and shingle grit, and they sag when the fasteners let go.
A hailstorm dents them and splits the seams. A plugged downspout backs up the whole run, and the water goes over the edge and down the wall.
We hang new gutters and downspouts, repair the ones you have, clean them out and put screens on top to keep debris out. If the wood behind a gutter has gone soft, we replace it.
Gutter work moves fast, and you get a straight answer on what your house needs.

sections.quote: I had gutters put on my whole house and detached garage. The GS Gutter crew did a fantastic job. They were very fast and friendly. … They made sure I was happy with the job before they left.
sections.name: Randy V.

sections.heading: Siding
body: Siding takes the Kansas wind, hail and summer sun before anything else on the house does.
When it's tired, you can see it: faded or chalky panels, cracks, pieces that have worked loose. What you can't see is the wall behind it, where a gap lets water in.
We install new siding and trim, and we repair damaged siding when a repair is all the wall needs. When we leave, the job site is clean.

sections.heading: Interior and Exterior Painting
body: Peeling paint on the trim and soffit is usually the first place a house shows its age. Paint is the skin over the wood at the edges of your house, and bare wood soaks up water.
Paint over rotted wood fails again in a year or two. So where the wood behind a gutter or along the trim has rotted, we replace it, and the paint goes on something solid.
We paint outside and inside, and a freshly painted house looks cared for. Paint the trim and doors while the crew is already there, and you won't need to call a painter later.

sections.quote: GS Gutters LLC did a great job on our house. They repaired our gutters, and fixed the rotted wood around the gutters as needed. They also did a great job painting the trim, doors and soffit around the house.

sections.heading: Decks
body: A deck gets sun and rain on top and damp underneath.
Boards go gray, then soft. Railings loosen. Eventually you stop trusting a step.
We build new decks and repair worn ones. If your siding, paint or gutters are on the same list, the same crew can do them while we're at the house.

sections.quote: My deck looks very nice. He did my siding, paint and gutters last time. That's why I wanted him for my deck project. His prices are fair and craftsmanship is very good. I'll call him for my next project!

sections.heading: When New Gutters Are the Answer
body: Sometimes you can tell from the driveway. A run of gutter has pulled away from the house, a seam drips every time it rains, or the whole thing sags in the middle.
Other times it's what's under the gutter: streaked siding, soft wood along the roof edge, a puddle at the foundation where the downspout should have sent the water.

Gutters take a beating in Kansas. Hail dents them and splits seams, wind loosens the fasteners, and leaves and shingle grit pack the troughs. After enough of that, patching one section only moves the problem down the line.
When the whole run is tired, replacing it is cheaper than coming back to it every spring.

sections.heading: What a New Gutter Job Includes
body: We replace the gutters and the downspouts together, because one without the other doesn't move water.
You get a new run along every edge that needs one, and downspouts that carry the water to the ground instead of down your siding.
You get the price after a free estimate, before the work starts.

sections.heading: Why Gutters Matter to the Rest of the House
body: A roof sheds a surprising amount of water in a hard rain. Gutters catch it at the edge and send it away from the walls and the foundation.
Without them, that water lands next to the house, splashes mud up the siding and soaks into the ground by the foundation. A good run keeps the wall dry from the top.

sections.heading: Where the Downspouts Go
body: A gutter is only as good as its downspouts. Too few, and the trough fills faster than it can drain and spills over the front. The same goes for a downspout that drops water right at the foundation.
How many you need depends on how long the run is and how much roof drains into it. We look at your house and tell you.
If the plan changes once we're up on the ladder, we'll tell you and work it in.

sections.heading: Gutter Repair
body: Not every gutter needs replacing. If the run is sound and one piece has failed, repair is the better call.
We fix sagging sections, leaking seams and gutters that were hung badly in the first place. If the wood behind them has rotted, we replace that too, so the new fasteners have something to hold.

sections.quote: Great job on cleaning the gutters, even fixed one that was improperly installed for no extra charge! Will be hiring again to install gutter guards and fix siding.

sections.heading: Gutter Cleaning
body: Clogged gutters overflow, and an overflowing gutter soaks the wall behind it. A plugged downspout is worse, because the whole run fills and sits.
We clear the gutters and the downspouts so the water runs again, including a downspout that has plugged.

sections.quote: Excellent work and very affordable. Cleaned area and downspout that was plugged. Showed pics of gutters after cleaning, hadn’t seen them that clean in quite awhile.

sections.heading: Gutter Screens
body: If you're tired of climbing a ladder every fall, screens on top of your gutters keep leaves and debris out of the trough.
They don't make a gutter maintenance-free. Fine grit still gets through, and a screen needs a look now and then. But they cut the number of times you need a cleaning.
We install gutter screens on top of your gutters.

We also do [siding](/siding-installation-wichita-ks/), painting inside and out, decks, and windows and doors.

sections.heading: When Siding Is Tired
body: Siding takes the Kansas wind, hail and summer sun before anything else on your house does.
When it's wearing out, you can see it. Panels fade or turn chalky, crack, warp or work loose, and trim around the windows and corners starts to split.
What you can't see is the wall behind it. A gap or a missing piece lets water in, and wet sheathing rots quietly for years before it shows inside.

sections.heading: Repair or Replace
body: If the damage is one section, say a few panels a storm cracked or a spot where the trim has rotted, a repair may be all the wall needs. We repair siding and trim, and we'll tell you when that's the better choice.
If the siding is worn across the house, patching only buys time. New siding gives you a wall that's tight against the weather again.
Either way, you get a free estimate and a price before we start.

sections.heading: What New Siding Includes
body: We install new siding and trim together, so the edges around windows, doors and corners are finished the same way as the walls.
Then we clean up. The job site is clean when we leave, and one homeowner said we cleaned up very well.

sections.heading: Siding, Trim, Paint and Windows in One Job
body: Siding doesn't stand alone. It meets the trim, the windows, the doors and the gutters at the roof edge, and water finds whichever one was left for later.

We're one crew for all of it. On one recent whole-house job we replaced two thirds of the siding and trim, painted the house and trim, installed five new windows and a new garage door to the backyard, and hung new gutters and gutter covers.

sections.quote: GS Gutters did a wonderful job on replacing 2/3 of our siding and trim, painting the house and trim, installing a new garage door to the backyard, installing five new windows, and new gutters and premium gutter covers. They got the whole project done within about a couple of weeks and kept us posted throughout. … There was an emphasis on building it right and keeping the water out of the house, and that is a great comfort. I still smile every time I look at the house.
sections.name: Lane P.

sections.heading: What Decides the Price
body: Siding prices move with the size of the house and the number of stories. They move with how much trim there is, how many windows and corners the siding has to work around, and what the wall looks like once the old siding is off.
A plain wall goes quickly, and a good estimate accounts for that. A wall with a lot of cut-ins and a bad surprise behind it takes longer.
That's why we look at your house before we quote it. The estimate is free, and you'll know the price before the work starts.

sections.heading: Why Trim Matters More Than It Looks
body: Most leaks in a sided wall start at an edge, not in the middle of a panel. The edges are the windows, the doors, the corners and the line under the roof.
New siding with old, cracked trim is a new wall with the same weak points. That's why we install siding and trim together.

sections.heading: Doing It in Stages
body: You don't have to do the whole house at once. Start with the wall that's costing you the most, and plan the rest after.

Because the same crew does gutters, [new gutters](/gutter-installation-wichita-ks/) and siding can go in together or one after the other. Water at the roof edge is the thing that wrecks siding, so gutters are a smart partner for it.
We also paint inside and out, build decks, and install windows and doors, so the work that meets your siding can be done by the same crew.

footer.about: I'm Nelson Galdamez, and I founded GS Gutters LLC, an insured Wichita company. We do gutters, siding, painting, decks, floors, windows and doors.

why: Your customers hire you for the whole outside of the house. Lane P. hired you for siding, trim, paint, five windows, a garage door and new gutters in one project. Luis R. came back for a deck after you did his siding, paint and gutters.

Your website says gutters. The top of your homepage promises “Superior Gutter Solutions” with no headline, so Google files you as a gutter company, and people searching for siding or a deck in Wichita don't find you.

So we built a demo that says exterior remodeling company in Wichita at the very top, gives gutter installation and siding installation their own pages, and puts your reviews next to the work they describe.
strategy.cardsHeading: Be the Exterior Company People Find on Google

cards.title: Homepage
cards.why: The first page people see, and the one Google reads to learn what you do.
problems: The top of your homepage says “Superior Gutter Solutions” and has no main headline, so Google never sees siding, paint or decks.
On a phone, your homepage sits blank for about two and a half seconds before your name appears.
None of your 52 reviews is shown anywhere.
fixes: A headline that says exterior remodeling company in Wichita, KS, right at the top.
Your name and number on screen the moment the page opens.
Every service listed, with reviews beside each.
cards.alsoAdd: On day one, we sit down with you to get what makes you the obvious choice, every service you offer and every town you work in. That becomes the prescription: how many pages, in how many towns, so Google and AI tools can find you for every service.

Is 1243 N Poplar St open to customers, or should the address stay off the site?
